svg.title: Revenue becomes stocks. Play earns a share.
svg.desc: Trading revenue funds treasury stock purchases. Approved acquired Stock Token units are allocated to eligible Brokers through activity weights. Delivery is to the canonical ERC-6551 account of an equipped deed. Eligibility requires a living registered character, finalized equipment, active Broker window, qualifying activity, no release notice and live delivery checks. A wallet-held NFT, pending equipment or dead-character custody does not qualify. Implementation snapshot 30 OCT 2026. Prelaunch: deployment and activation are not verified by this diagram. Sources: src/brokers.js:130; src/stockdeliver.js:86; omerta-contracts/src/DeedStockAccount.sol:63.

g.text: Outside game = no new stocks. No fixed payout or APY.
